xmldoc.short_description: Read XML data as a structure

param_input_item.param_description: a string: path to the XML file.

param_output_item.param_description: a structure, scalar value, cell array, or structure array depending on the XML content.

description.p: readstruct reads XML elements into Nelson values. Attributes are imported by default with the suffix 'Attribute'.

example_item.example_item_description: Read XML data into a Nelson structure.
Read one selected XML element with an XPath selector.
